completion:
Fill in the incident date (the date on which the incident occurred). Note: Do not fill in the date on which the incident was reported.
3. Under "bills paid" place the amount of the bill paid in the year the incident occurred. Note that bills paid in a given year do not count for reporting unless they are for treatment of injuries received in the year immediately preceding.
4. Furloughed days in the year of the injury must be counted, not furloughed days in the year immediately preceding the year of injury.
5. Days lost from previous incidents are not counted as lost time for the current incident.
6. If an incident occurs while leaving the job on a Friday, do not count the weekend lost time.
7. Count the date on which the incident occurred as a day lost.
